title: polygala forojulensis subsp. adriatica
intro: Polygala forojulensis subsp. adriatica, commonly known as Adriatic Milkwort, is a perennial plant species in the Polygalaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polygala forojulensis subsp. adriatica include anti-diabetic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, may contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
